relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP activates both the canonical CGRP receptor and amylin receptor 1 (AMY1; Figure 1C).e26

relationships.subject: erenumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Constipation was identified as a potential adverse drug reaction with erenumab based on premarketing clinical trials

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP also plays a role in the gut in gastric acid secretion, inflammation, motility, and nociception (Figure 1B).11

key_findings: CGRP regulates GI motility, nociception, inflammation; CGRP-targeting therapies cause GI adverse events, notably constipation with erenumab.
FAERS GI AE proportions: erenumab 16.4%, galcanezumab 9.6%.
